articles.summary: National CineMedia, Inc. announced the strategic acquisition of Spotlight Cinema Networks, adding high‑scale luxury cinema inventory, increasing national market share by ~6% and expanding presence in key New York and Los Angeles markets by 30%. This move strengthens NCM’s platform for premium advertisers and aligns with its growth strategy for 2026 and beyond.
articles.title: National CineMedia, Inc. Announces Strategic Acquisition of Spotlight Cinema Networks to Enhance Advertising Network and Expand Reach Among Luxury Audiences
